channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Luke 6:31
item.description:
“And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.”

Luke 6:31 (KJV)

Treat others the way you want to be treated — simple, but it changes everything. Before you act today, flip it around: how would I want this done to me? Then do that.

Prayer: Lord, help me treat others as I want to be treated.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Matthew 5:8
item.description:
“Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.”

Matthew 5:8 (KJV)

A pure heart sees God more clearly — in Scripture, in circumstances, in people. Purity isn't about perfection; it's about direction. Keep your heart pointed toward Him today.

Prayer: God, purify my heart so I can see You clearly.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Psalm 56:3
item.description:
“What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.”

Psalm 56:3 (KJV)

Fear is a signal, not a master. When afraid, David had a simple plan: trust God. You don't need a complicated strategy — just turn your fear into trust, one moment at a time.

Prayer: Lord, when I am afraid, I will trust in You.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Acts 20:35
item.description:
“I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.”

Acts 20:35 (KJV)

Giving isn't losing; it's gaining. Jesus said givers are the truly blessed ones. Try it today and see.

Prayer: Lord, make me a cheerful giver.

item.title: Daily Devotional: John 8:32
item.description:
“And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

John 8:32 (KJV)

Truth is not just information; it is liberation. The things that keep you bound lose power when exposed to Christ's truth. Know it, live it, and walk free.

Prayer: Jesus, Your truth sets me free.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Psalm 30:5
item.description:
“For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.”

Psalm 30:5 (KJV)

Weeping has a curfew — joy comes in the morning. If last night was hard, this is your reminder: this isn't the end of the story. Morning is coming.

Prayer: God, thank You that joy comes in the morning.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 2 Corinthians 4:16
item.description:
“For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.”

2 Corinthians 4:16 (KJV)

Your body may get tired, but your inner self can be renewed every single day. Don't focus only on the outward — feed your spirit. Today's renewal is available right now.

Prayer: Lord, renew my inner man day by day.
